pages.text: Once Blade Wave is unlocked, you can switch between $(thing)Heal$() and $(thing)Blade Wave$() using the skill switch key. Switching costs a significant amount of soul energy, so commit to your choice.$(br2)$(l)Heal$() turns the sword into a sustain-focused weapon. You sacrifice ranged damage for survivability.$(br2)$(l)Blade Wave$() turns the sword into an aggressive, ranged-capable weapon. You sacrifice self-healing for damage.

pages.title: Synergy with Armor
pages.text: These two modes interact well with $(thing)Soul Armor$(). Since the armor provides its own survivability through Soul Rage, you may find that Blade Wave becomes the stronger choice when fully armored — freeing you from needing the sword's heal.$(br2)Conversely, if you are not wearing soul armor, Heal may be essential for staying alive in extended fights.
